footer.brandDesc: A tree-structured prompt management tool to keep your AI prompts organized.

landing.heroSubtitle: Manage prompts with a tree structure, variable filling {variable}, offline-first, and multi-device sync.
landing.ctaFreeNote: Free to use · No sign-up required
landing.featuresDesc: A prompt management tool designed for the AI era — bring order to chaos.
landing.feature1Desc: Organize your prompts like a file manager with unlimited nesting, drag-and-drop sorting, and collapse memory.
landing.feature2Desc: Create reusable templates with {'{{variable}}'} syntax. Auto-detect variables when copying and generate final content with one click.
landing.feature3Desc: All data is stored locally first. Works without internet. Syncs automatically when connected — never lose your work.
landing.feature4Desc: Full coverage across Web App, iOS & Android, and browser extensions. Manage your prompts anytime, anywhere.
landing.feature5Desc: Select prompts directly on ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other AI pages. Insert into the input box with one click.
landing.feature6Desc: Browse your prompt library as an interactive mind map. Get a bird's-eye view of your knowledge structure.
landing.feature7Desc: Generate online share links for a prompt or folder. Anyone with the link can view and copy without logging in.
landing.feature8Desc: Create API keys so scripts, automations, and internal tools can call PromptTree data securely.
landing.feature9Desc: Combine official Agent Skills with your prompt workflows to standardize reusable capabilities across teams.
landing.platformsDesc: No matter where you work, PromptTree is right there with you.
landing.platformWebDesc: Full-featured in your browser with a sleek macOS-style interface.
landing.platformMobileDesc: Native mobile app with drill-down navigation and gesture-optimized interactions.
landing.platformExtDesc: Supports ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Poe and other popular AI platforms.
landing.scenariosDesc: No matter what type of AI user you are, PromptTree can help.
landing.scenario1Desc: Build a library of writing, translation, and polishing prompt templates. Use variables to quickly swap topics and boost productivity.
landing.scenario2Desc: Manage code review, bug analysis, and architecture design prompts. Organize by project and language for quick access.
landing.scenario3Desc: Systematically manage experiment prompts, compare different versions, and track iterations with tree structures.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to Get Your Prompts Organized?
landing.ctaDesc: Free to use, no credit card required. Supports offline mode — no sign-up needed to try.
landing.metaDesc: PromptTree — A tree-structured prompt manager with variable filling, online sharing, API key calls, Agent Skills support, offline-first design, and multi-device sync.

features.pageDesc: PromptTree is built for prompt management in the AI era. Every feature is carefully crafted.
features.metaDesc: PromptTree Features — Tree structure management, variable filling, public share links, API key access, offline-first, multi-device sync, and browser extension.
features.treeDesc: Manage your prompts like macOS Finder. Mix folders and prompts, unlimited nesting, drag-and-drop sorting. Collapse/expand states sync across devices seamlessly.
features.variableDesc: Define variable placeholders in prompts using {'{{variable}}'} syntax. Variables are auto-detected when copying, fill in values and get the final prompt copied to clipboard. Reuse the same template endlessly.
features.offlineDesc: All data is stored locally in IndexedDB first. View and edit on the subway, on a plane, or anywhere without internet. Auto-syncs when connected — never lose your data.
features.syncDesc: Three-way sync across Web App, native iOS & Android apps, and browser extension. Organize on your computer, browse on your phone, use on ChatGPT. Data stays consistent via incremental sync.
features.extensionDesc: On ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Poe and other AI chat pages, pick prompts directly from the tree directory and insert into the input box with one click. No window switching needed.
features.shareDesc: Create a secure share link for a prompt or an entire folder. Teammates can open and copy content instantly without creating an account.
features.apiAccessDesc: Generate scoped API keys for programmatic access. Connect PromptTree to scripts, workflow tools, and internal platforms while keeping revocation simple.
features.mindmapDesc: Browse your entire prompt library as an interactive mind map. Understand your category structure at a glance and quickly locate target nodes. Supports zoom, pan, and collapse/expand.
features.outlineDesc: Browse all prompts in a flat outline format with quick search and filtering. Perfect for quick lookup and batch operations.
features.darkDesc: Automatically follows your system theme for light/dark mode. Built with macOS 15 Sequoia design language — frosted glass effects, subtle shadows, refined visual experience.
features.keyboardDesc: Comprehensive keyboard shortcut support for creating, searching, navigating, and copying — never leave your keyboard. A productivity multiplier for power users.
features.ctaDesc: Free to use, supports offline mode. No sign-up needed to get started.
